items.title: SD-071: the SD-068 nrem slot-filling and sws pattern-completion readouts are content-contingent instruments (the non-diagnostic evidence run)
items.note: SD-071 EVIDENCE run -- the one artifact the claim still needed and structurally could not obtain: a NON-DIAGNOSTIC run tagging it. SD-071 asserts the SD-068 nrem (nrem_transfer_fidelity, harness:523 called :1039) and sws (_sws_pattern_completion, harness:400 called :379) consolidation readouts are CONTENT-CONTINGENT INSTRUMENTS. Its what_would_answer records that both supporting runs (V3-EXQ-778c, V3-EXQ-778g) are experiment_purpose=diagnostic and therefore do not weight governance confidence. | CARVE-OUT, AND WHY THIS RUN IS PERMITTED TO BE NON-DIAGNOSTIC: until 2026-09-18 the harness carried an UNCONDITIONAL 'Any run built on it MUST be EXPERIMENT_PURPOSE=diagnostic' contract under 'Prerequisite caveat -- MECH-121 hold', so SD-071's own promotion condition was unsatisfiable. Raised as GFLAG-0319, refused at the /queue-experiment STOP-GATE by science-20260918-sd071-consolidation-readouts, and DECIDED BY THE USER 2026-09-18T19:47:16Z via the Orchestrator decision lane (orchestrate-20260918-1840-cloud4, real AskUserQuestion): OPTION A, grant the narrow carve-out. Amendment landed and verified on origin at both caveat sites -- REE_assembly d202c2d73c, ree-v3 6371c9fc8a; GFLAG-0319 resolved (876429a2d4); EXP-1178/EVB-1657 lifted blocked_on_gate -> proposed (6d0427b432). The carve-out is an ENUMERATION, not a category: non-diagnostic only when claim_ids are solely instrument-validity claims (enumerated {SD-071}) AND neither MECH-120 nor MECH-121 is tagged. BOTH conditions are ASSERTED IN CODE before any compute (_assert_carveout_conditions): claim_ids is exactly ['SD-071'], deliberately NOT 778c/778g's ['SD-068','MECH-168','INV-047','MECH-169'] -- repeating that 'context' tagging would void condition (i). The staging claims are named as PROVENANCE only and are not weighted. MECH-121's status is untouched under every outcome. MECH-170 does NOT meet the condition and was NOT added to the enumeration (behavioural recovery-order prediction, depends_on MECH-120 and MECH-121 directly); carried to the user as decision chip chip-20260918-mech170-carveout-scope. | CRITERIA, TRANSCRIBED FROM SD-071's OWN FALSIFIER, NOT INVENTED. C1 (load-bearing, cohort-level): ceiling_inside_ci95 FALSE on BOTH legs, ceiling 0.25, CI95 over the per-seed null_slope_ratio at n=8 via the harness's shared subgroup_ratio_stats (:1446) on the C2-eligible subgroup -- 'REFUTED if a re-run at n>=8 puts ceiling_inside_ci95 true on either leg'. C3 (load-bearing, sws only): sws content-scale ladder signed spread > 0.01 on all seeds -- 'REFUTED ... if the sws leg's content-scale ladder collapses below the 0.01 floor'. C2 (readiness, not scientific): |injected sigma-slope| >= 1e-6 on both legs. overall_pass = C2 AND C1 AND C3. C1 gates BOTH legs, where 778g scoped its C1 to sws alone; the rem leg stays CONTEXT-only (known degenerate at both clamp rails, owned by the GOV-FANOUT-1 portfolio 778d/e/f) because SD-071 does not claim it. Recorded but NOT gated, because SD-071 pre-registers neither and adding a gate the claim did not name would change what the run can conclude: 778g's 3.0x ladder signal-ratio bar, and ci95_high_below_ceiling per leg. | red-team (fable; model diversity from the authoring session's Opus 5): CONTESTED -> 2 findings, BOTH verified against source, 1 FIXED and 1 RECORDED-not-designed-around with its reason, 0 dismissed silently. F1 (the substantive one, CONFIRMED BIT-EXACTLY): C3's content-scale ladder is a SIGMA-REPARAMETERISATION of the injected arm's own damage curve, not an independent content-tracking probe. Damage is referenced to the UNSCALED content (diffuse_perturb rms_ref=...) so it is held fixed while content is scaled by cs, and under the sws readout's SCALE-INVARIANT cosine that makes error(content_scale=cs, sigma=s) == error(content_scale=1.0, sigma=s/cs). Verified against 778g's own recorded ladder_error_series on its doubling sigma grid: rung0.5[i] == rung1.0[i+1] and rung0.25[i] == rung1.0[i+2] for every i>=1, EXACT on 8/8 seeds. So what C3 ACTUALLY tests is that the injected damage curve is GRADED rather than step-shaped -- real and failable (a saturating curve gives spread ~0 and C3 fails), hence NOT vacuous and the run still answers its own question -- but C3 does NOT independently discharge the scale-invariance caveat that SD-071's what_would_answer and 778g's docstring both credit it with. Same root cause, recorded alongside: the sws NULL-arm error series is {0,c,c,c,c} (n_distinct 2, 8/8 seeds in 778g), flat above sigma=0 because the cosine annihilates the sigma factor on a pure-noise store, so the sws null SLOPE is driven entirely by the sigma=0 discontinuity. NOT designed around: C1 and C3 are the claim's own pre-registered criteria and re-scoping either is a governance call, not a queue session's -- raised instead as GFLAG-0351 (evidence_discrepancy on SD-071), which asks governance to weight an SD-071 PASS accordingly and to decide whether an independent anti-scale-invariance check is owed (that would be a NEW instrument, /implement-substrate, not another lettered iteration). F2 (FIXED): because C1 is stated as ceiling_inside_ci95 == false, a leg whose CI95 sits entirely ABOVE the ceiling PASSES C1 while being fully CONFOUNDED, which refutes the claim; the draft then fell through to evidence_direction 'mixed', contradicting the driver's own docstring. Now routes to 'weakens' ahead of the pass cases, with label consolidation_readout_leg_confounded and non_degenerate=false (excluded from confidence scoring). outcome is deliberately LEFT as the pre-registered rule computes it -- changing the pass rule would change a criterion the claim itself fixes -- so outcome=PASS with direction=weakens is DIAGNOSTIC of exactly that case and is named in interpretation.outcome_vs_direction_note. Two further reviewer facts recorded rather than acted on: C2's requeue branch is effectively unreachable (its 1e-6 floor is 4-5 orders below where C1 already fails), so a reduced-sensitivity outcome routes to 'weakens' never 'unknown'; and the nrem DV runs through ree_core/sleep/cross_module_consolidation.py's CrossModuleConsolidator (MECH-121 consolidation cluster per its own module header) stepping with torch.optim.Adam (:162), whose non-linear per-parameter normalisation is what keeps the nrem ratio off the 1.0 an affine consolidator would force -- so that leg is not fully operator-agnostic. Neither breaches the carve-out (its conditions are about TAGGING), but the carve-out's RATIONALE sentence was narrowed at both sites from 'cannot bear on MECH-121 even incidentally' to 'cannot MOVE MECH-121's status', CONDITIONS UNCHANGED -- REE_assembly 390ebeec64, ree-v3 057bb32b45, logged on GFLAG-0351. Reviewer family 1 (does the manipulation reach the DV): no finding; the cached= ladder reuse is exact and both arms rebuild agent and generator per cell. | Step 2.4 GOV-REUSE-1: decisive readout = ceiling_inside_ci95 on both legs' per-seed null_slope_ratio from a NON-diagnostic run tagging SD-071. reanalysis_query.py --readout null_slope_ratio --claim SD-071 returned 0 matches; a hand grep of the manifest corpus finds the readout on 778b/778c/778g, but ZERO manifests tag SD-071 at all and all three are experiment_purpose=diagnostic. No reanalysis of a diagnostic manifest can make it non-diagnostic, so the missing artifact is not derivable post-hoc -> ran. substrate_hash has also moved since both runs (harness 76508144, b42f69ff, 6371c9fc8a, 057bb32b45), so their cells would be INCOMPATIBLE for reuse regardless. | Step 2.5: SD-071 status=candidate, implementation_phase v3, substrate fully built and verified live by the pre-flight (both legs are real functions with real call sites). Step 2.5b re-derive brake on SD-071 = 0 hits across 523 autopsy artifacts. Step 2.5c: no OPEN corrupting substrate_queue entry overlaps this driver's path -- it reaches the SD-068 harness and the sleep consolidation/SHY paths directly and builds no SleepLoopManager. Step 2.6 ethics preflight: all flags false, decision allow (SENT-0). | PROVENANCE: validate_experiments.py --strict clean (0 findings on all 37 checks) both before and after the red-team fix; validate_recording.py --strict clean on the dry-run manifest (0 always-core gaps, 0 flat-scalar findings, 0 criteria-re-derivability findings); --dry-run smoke run TWICE (before and after the fix), rc=0 both times with bit-identical numbers, so the fix provably did not move the measurement. All four readiness anchors replay the frozen known-healthy 778g reference at 8/8 under the shipped predicate. ep N/M denominator = len(sigmas) = 5 = episodes_per_run; seeds x conditions = 8 x 1 = 8 = the number of verdict: lines. estimated_minutes 30 from 778g's recorded elapsed_seconds 1160 on ree-cloud-2 at identical sweep+ladder structure (the nrem leg adds no compute -- both legs read the same run_null_content_control call). KNOWN GAP, stated not hidden: z_goal_stream is NOT RECORDED, because the SD-068 harness constructs its agents internally and the driver holds no agent handle at manifest-write time -- same as every other driver in this family.
